text:
Finally found a place where the individual is the focus and their complaints are taken seriously.
Ms. Siwalai took the time before the treatment to get to know me and my symptoms, asking all the necessary questions.
I've had severe back and knee pain for years due to sports injuries. In Germany i was never taken seriously and didn't receive helpful treatment from doctors because I was so young and it was "considered unbelievable at my age" (26).
Here, my age wasn't a factory, instead, my symptoms were addressed and treated specifically.
Yes, the therapy was strenuous and painful (the liberating kind of pain), and I still felt it for a few days afterward. However, I immediately noticed and saw a significant improvement.

Now, a week after the treatment i still feel much much better than before and my pain has significantly decreased.

Unfortunately my stay in Hua Hin was too short to have several therapy sessions but I will definitely come back and plan in more days.

Thank you so much for your help
Absolutely marvellous had the lymphatic drain message , they did a fantastic job very happy with service, feeling a lot better

Excellent massage therapist who would definitely fix your problem! I had a lump on the side of my neck and lots of tension. She began with massage my feet and my leg for just 10 mins then that swollen lump on my neck is gone. It’s a miracle!!! Definitely coming back for more

Ms Siwalai is truly incredible. She knows what she’s doing and activates just the right amount of pain in the body in order to awaken the system and bring it back to life.
We often neglect certain parts of our bodies without even realizing it. But that’s where the help is needed the most because the energy stops flowing
Thank you so much for your help in restoring my body 🙏

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to K. Siwalai and her associates for their exceptional rehabilitation massage therapy services.

I arrived there for my ACL and MCL tear recovery. Thanks to their expertise, I was able to regain the confidence and mobility to walk without a cane!

Although the process was intense, it was incredibly rewarding, and I felt incredible after every session.

One of the things I appreciated most was that all of the products used were natural, which was a big plus for me.

To top it off, K. Siwalai even offered me a fresh coconut after my session, which was a refreshing treat.

Overall, I would highly recommend her services to anyone in need of rehabilitation massage therapy. Thanks again for everything!

Fantastic. The massage was tailored to my needs and really focused on my problem areas. A bit pricey but you really get what you pay for. For the first time I've not had to think about my chronic pain issues

Very lucky to have found Patcharapat.
My bursitis pain was negligible after my first visit. And they are so gentle with my back pain. I'll keep coming back 🙏 …

This is more than a review. THIS IS THANK YOU! I am more grateful to Siwalai and her team of healers than words can ever say but I’m going to try with this review.

If you want the short version… here: 10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

If you want to know why, read on.

After a military training accident, I had a spinal surgery to replace two discs in my upper spine. Since the surgery and for a period of more than 10 years, I suffered from radiating pains, tingling sensations, numbness, muscle spasms and constant stiffness in my arms and legs that was mostly tolerable but ALWAYS present. I accepted my condition and dealt with it the best I could.
In 2023, my entire case took a nosedive and I went from walking on my own, to cane-assisted, to a walker, and even a motorized buggy. I was hospitalized for a short period, saw at least a dozen doctors and specialists and went through the whole alphabet in tests (X-Ray, CT, MRI, etc.). No treatment, therapy, or drug saw any real improvement and by the end of 2023, I’d accepted that this was just my new reality.
Then my wife and I booked a 2 week vacation to Thailand and while looking at all the activities available, my wife did some Googling and found Patcharapat Spa. We took a chance, booked an appointment, and it was the best decision I’ve made in recent memory.

Siwalai is NOT your average Thai masseuse and this is NOT your average Thai massage! If that’s what you’re looking for, take $10 or $20 and go to any of the dozens of massage parlors located within a block of your hotel. Khun charges a premium. A 90-min deep tissue massage is about $90 but I would’ve paid DOUBLE for what she did for me.
After a brief consultation and a few questions about my history, they got to work. Siwalai and her assistant put me on a table and twisted me into every shape imaginable. This was not a relaxing massage. They smoothed out old pains, created some new ones, and then smoothed those out too. At times, I felt I was in an actual meat grinder but I came out of the other side feeling better than when she started. That night in bed, I could still feel THROBBING in the muscles she’d touched.

On her recommendation, (and after negotiating a nice discount), I went to see her FIVE MORE DAYS IN A ROW! I dreaded seeing her every morning in the middle of my vacation but I could not argue with the results: My muscle spasms disappeared.  I felt better. I moved better. I kept l forgetting my cane everywhere because I walked better! IT WAS AMAZING!
I’m back home now and while I’m not cured, I don’t wake up in crippling pain anymore. I still carry my cane but it’s mostly for stability while I retrain myself how to walk. I’ve got to regain some muscle on one side and it’s going to take a lot of work on my part but I'm motivated. While she tortured my body, she beat it into my head that I’m the one who has to keep this up by stretching and exercising every single day. If I combine that with regular sessions by a trained masseuse, I’ll have years of active life left in me. My entire attitude has changed right along with the changes in my body and I am forever grateful to Siwalai and her entire team.
See you all soon! My next trip to Thailand is already being planned!

A once in a life time healing experience! Unless you are lucky enough to visit more than once, which I highly recommend. Once is not enough!! Even if you are fit and healthy it is well worth the money.
It’s true, it’s painful at times. But she doesn’t ‘hurt’ you. The improved circulation and movement you will feel is worth the short term pain.
Trust Siwalai. Her experience and passion will improve your vitality but be prepared for some very deep pressure points.
Expert in Lymphatic massage.
Just an easy short walk from the bus.

COME HERE IF YOU NEED A MIRACLE!!! I traveled all the way from America, by way of NYC, to find Dr. Siwalai. I was depressed, in PAIN, weak, and of low energy. I tried to stress what I what going through and was afraid she didn't understand because she quickly assessed that I needed an "Insomnia Set". But she GOT IT! She understood perfectly. My energy is attractive now, my vibrations are higher than ever, and my chronic fatigue is gone! My mood has drastically changed from being down to being upbeat (And my heart is full of gratitude <3)

WARNING ⚠️: This is NOT a place for those just looking for a nice rub down. Her prices are commensurate with her EXPERIENCE! You might think it cost more than other local places, but you get way MORE, here, than what you pay for at other places! You get to AVOID MEDICAL BILLS by coming here. You get to AVOID MULTIPLE SESSIONS (unless you want them). You get to AVOID RECURRING PAIN. And you GET HEALED!!! TRUST ME!
I've been to a fair share of massages all around the world and this by far is one of the best, as the lady believes herself, her massage is to fix you and not just to relax you.

We visited Ms Siwalai about 20 years ago when she cured my husband’s chronic back pain after one session of therapy.  20 years older, my husband had new back and knee pains. Ms Siwalai cured him after 3 sessions again.

For myself, I have had chronic headache, neck, and shoulder pain for the last 15 years for which I sought help from many other doctors and physiotherapists. Unfortunately, despite those visits, neither the cause was able to be diagnosed nor any improvement made after numerous times / types of treatment.   I finally visited Ms Siwalai in January.  After a few sessions, I would not say I am cured but certainly my condition has been greatly improved. Ms Siwalai’s massage is certainly not a relaxing massage. It is a therapeutic massage and quite physically demanding. I felt pain every time during my visit but on the other hand, my old chronic pain was being relieved.  So, although painful, the treatment was helping me. The pain during the massage was paid off by gain.

Yes, Ms Siwalai charges more than other masseuses charge but from my point of view it is worth every penny. This is not a simple relax massage, it is a physiotherapy treatment.  Ms Siwalai is aware I could not come back to see her very often. Hence, she even taught me the exercises I should do at home to help myself.  I still continue with the exercises she taught me and all my pain is definitely relieved.  I have total trust in her and she is truly kind-hearted. Her motivation is to help release people from their pains and we are so glad to have met her.

Wow. I finally found the best thai therapeutic massage I was looking for. Allopathic medicine and therapies aren't not good for me and make me sick. I can't anymore. But there are alternatives...
This is real natural therapy, the one that really works for me.  👍🙏🏻
I will come as many times as I can. Thank you for doing this great job, it is so important for people.

K. Siwalai is a very experienced and wonderfully warm person who is able to identify issues within your body and remedy them before they become much more serious.
I explained my knee arthritis problem to her, which she then started to address by kneading under my opposite side arm. Incredibly when I stood up after the 'massage' the knee felt considerably better. The massage did cause some pain during the process but afterwards the benefits were genuine and long lasting.
I can thoroughly recommend her.

She is MAGIC ✨ Literally the only way I can describe her 😃 I went to Swali with L5/S1 disc excursion/herniation, which lead to sciatica pain. I was in pain for almost 4 months. I could barely walk, stand or sit. After 2-3 sessions per week of physiotherapy back in Australia for 4 months, there was only 10% improvement. But just 2 sessions with Swali I was able to RUN! (yes, run). My pain was gone more than 50%. I went to Thailand just to get treatment from Swali and it was totally worth it. I can not thank her and her team for helping with this pain management. She is also super kind, hospitable and a wonderful person in general. Thank you so so much. I am looking forward to my next session next week 🙏

I visited here with back pain and was unable to bend over, the treatment was tough and very sore but of course in a good way, I have suffered a lot with hip and back pain over the last few years, this lady was the best I have seen and was able to explain where the pain was coming from. I have been treated in 6 different countries and by far the best person I have come across, must see if in pain or sore in Hua Hin

I've had lower back issues for years, due to my time in Afghanistan and my military career.  The massages I received here were nothing close to relaxing, BUT damn, they gave me the most relief.  I literally felt like I had no injury, following the massage.
If you've exhausted your attempts to relieve your pain, look no further.  Give this kind lady, Siwalai a chance to help you relieve your pain.  You will not regret it.

This is the closest I have ever been to magic. Unbelievably the best medical massage I have experienced. Very painful because it was the exact right places that she touched. Very clean and great service, speak perfect english and makes sure you understand what is going on and why you feel the pain. I am very close to have my issues totally fixed. Stuff I have been battling with for years and years and that no doctors in Scandinavia have been able to cure. Price is high if you don’t know the result. But when you walk out with the problems fixed, it seems like a very fair deal. Thank you and I recommend to anyone!

Khun Siwalai, I am so grateful to have found you. You have helped me and my whole family reclaim the vitality and the energy that we were longing to find. Stress causes havoc in the system, months of stress due to the covid situation and the separation from loved ones: pain, digestive issues,  reduced range of motion, depression, anxiety, to name but a few. My symptoms were pages long, and then I found you. In just one session, I was changed. You spoke to me also, like nobody has ever done before. Your treatments and your methods, I have never come across anything like yours, and believe me I have tried a lot of different techniques! Khun Siwalai, thank you again for all that you do. The results of your treatments have raised my husband's, my daughter's and my energy. I am enthusiastic again, I have regained my optimism and my love for life, the pain is gone. To anybody considering your services, I would like to say: You must try it!

I highly recommend their service to those who are seeking to recover from chronic pain and physical discomfort. Their unique holistic methodology offers real lasting result. For some, it is considered a miracle.

In their hands, you will be given a great deal of dedicated care. Furthermore, they will teach you home practices so that you can be self reliant for your own well-being.

Very grateful to have found them and see tremendous result in my wish to recalibrate my physical body from a lower back hernia.

If you wish to live free from your physical pain, this is an investment worthy of indulging.

Thank you K Siwalai and associate.

Patcharapat Medi Spa - Thank you again !
We returned there after visits in prior years.
Khun Siwalai and her team knows very well the Asian healing arts.
a few visits helped to correct various chronic issues she also has a special facial treatment doing.
They also have a delicious herbal infusion

Been coming here once a week for last month and will continue every week until l leave. Was having migraines every couple of days, haven't had any since first treatment. They are excellent. Would highly recommend

Was lucky enough to get in for a lymphatic massage during my short stay in Hua Hin. It was intense but I feel amazing. I was massaged by Siwalai and another lovely woman. They knew where to focus. Again, intense.

I recommend this place from the bottom of my heart.If you have any kind of cronic pain issue they will help you start the journey towards a better life.This is much more a treatment clinic rather than a massage place and therefore you can not compare the prices they charge with a massage place. Having said that its still way cheaper than your home country if you can find somebody there with the insights and understanding these people have.After a few sessions I really felt they genuinely cared about me getting better. They also were honest about what lifestyle changes I would need to do to avoid the cronic issues returning...Thumbs up and please give these people a chance if you have any cronic issues..

If you are in Hua Hin I highly recommend visting Patcharapat rehab retreat if you struggle with any kind of chronic pain.The holistic understanding of how the body works is the key and they know how to give you the best treatment for your …

I would highly recommended for whom has pains impacting the physical body. My story was 1. Shoulder blocked (when I do work out sometimes my shoulder cannot be fully acting specially going backwards). 2. Lower back— I don’t really feel pain but I do always feel tired).
The reasons as following which pretty convinced. By a lovely lady. Ms. Siwalai.
1. She took more than half hour to understand where the pain comes from. How long it happened. When you feel the most pain...And then, who  analyzed why it happened. Her key point was not just the  certain area the pain originally comes from.... she did work out which area impacting to the certain painful area. Which was amazing!
2. The treatment. It took an hour. It was actually suffering experience for me which made me shouting out many times. However it’s helpful.
3. After twice treatments. I started to feel much relaxed on the shoulders and the lower back part. And also, I started doing the movement she taught me. I hope it will be recovered soon.
4. The cost. The cost is higher than others. But I do believe it’s reasonable. It’s worth for your health. We do like to have Less pains and healthy life, don’t we?

Great massage shop. Owner went above and beyond to help with arm pain ive had for years, and advice for stretching and exercise to alleviate ghd problems. Gave extra treatment for free. Would go back for sure

I tried to reserve, so quoted. Reply was 3300 Bhat/1.5 hour. It is more than 10 times than usual price. I didn't reserve. If this price is a rip-off, you should not go there. If it is worth it on the price, you need to review here! I cannot evaluate good-rating just on the price.
Khun Siwalai is very knowledgeable and experienced. She fixed my lingering back problem. Highly recommended pain relief!
Super massage i ever had
The treatment is amazing & it helps a lot.  The master was so nice & made the laugh during the treatment.  Live to recommend their service.
I have much less headache after a treatment here. But you have to go through pain to kill your pain. It is worth am try.
A miracle worker, for the body, never had a massage like that before. Can’t recommend enough!

Thank you very much

Omg this is the best massage place I have ever experienced hands down!!!!

You can feel how much heart goes into this place.

Thank you for making me feel so looked after. Hua Hin is lucky to have you. 💙

For anyone seeking not just quality, but genuine dedication, tangible results, and lasting change, Ms. Siwalai is an absolute gift. What she does goes far beyond a typical treatment – ​​you feel seen, understood, and cared for with great attention. Words simply cannot do it justice; the many positive reviews confirm exactly what we experienced ourselves.

This experience was truly special for both my wife Marcela and me. We thank her from the bottom of our hearts for her warm hospitality, attentiveness, and exceptional treatment. We will definitely be back and are already looking forward to seeing her again.

Marcela & Antonio

The session begins with a foot bath; I opted for an incredible lymphatic drainage massage, very professional and effective. After the massage, the fresh coconut is pure bliss. I highly recommend Patcharapat 🥰 …

I had a serious bicycle accident a week ago and broke my nose and neck. I received excellent treatment from Khun Siwalai. The masseuse was very careful with my fractures and even tended to my wounds and helped me find a hotel. Khun Siwalai …

I highly recommend this place. The massage is excellent, a therapeutic massage. The owner is very kind. I stop by every time I'm in Hua Hin. They can massage any ailment – ​​neck, shoulder, and back pain – and even facial massages! Your skin will look radiant after the massage!😜 …

Highly recommended.

First of all, I can confirm the other 5-star reviews.

Many thanks to Khun Siwalai.
Professional massage, pleasant atmosphere, very clean rooms and reasonable prices. Highly recommended!
A truly exceptional oil massage and shoulder rehabilitation, which I can move again to a greater extent. Thank you
I was absolutely not satisfied, I was completely blue in several places on my body, even though I was in so much pain I cried, I continued the massage anyway.
Exceptional and unique treatments which, although expensive, are worth every baht twice over. Thank you so much for your amazing work.

Professional, traditional, and welcoming—I loved it!!!

I went to Patcharapat Spa on a recommendation. I received a warm and professional welcome from the very beginning, from filling out a form and having my feet washed to enjoying a snack of delicious medicinal herbal tea and local fruits at the end of my treatment.

As an Ayurvedic practitioner, I can attest to the skill, healing nature, and immediate benefits of the treatments I received. From now on, this will be a must-visit whenever I'm in Hua Hin. Thank you to Khun Siwalai and the entire team.

I'm thrilled. A truly personalized therapeutic massage.

After struggling for several years with constant twitching in my face, around my right eye, which had caused significant tension in my facial muscles, Siwalai's treatment brought me tremendous relief in just two sessions. The third treatment, shortly before our return trip, was the breakthrough. Surprisingly, she no longer massaged my face, but only various other areas of my body. While the massages were sometimes painful, they were incredibly relieving afterward, as not only did the facial mobility return—without the twitching—but my shoulder and hip pain also disappeared. Everything in the body is interconnected. Siwalai knows exactly where to work. She also gives helpful tips for the period after the treatment, back home, so you know what you can do yourself for lasting healing.


Siwalai knows exactly where to work. Before, I was seeing a neurologist for my condition (he prescribed injections into the twitching nerve to suppress the reaction), and of course, I've been undergoing physiotherapy and osteopathic treatment for some time. This has always helped me to some extent, but not comprehensively. Other Thai massages I've tried haven't had the same effect either.

I can highly recommend Spa Patcharapat and Siwalai as a massage therapist.

I've had massages in many places and the stiffness in my shoulders never went away. I've had it healed at Patcharapat Khun Sivalai. It's great! If anyone has pain and massages that don't help, try getting a massage. They don't massage the area that hurts.
